newsitem.title: UK: IEA says March ex-Soviet oil exports up to 2.78 mb.
newsitem.headline: IEA says March ex-Soviet oil exports up to 2.78 mb.

text.p: Exports of crude and refined products from the territories of the former Soviet Union rose 110,000 barrels a day (bpd) in March to 2.78 million, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Tuesday.
The agency said the increase was probably a result of a government decision to cut export taxes.
The IEA, in a monthly report, said preliminary estimates showed seaborne exports jumped 130,000 bpd to 1.95 million bpd.
Pipeline exports to central and eastern Europe fell 20,000 bpd to 900,000 bpd.
Net product exports at 630,000 bpd were down 30,000 bpd in March but Russian gas oil exports stayed high at 370,000 bpd.
Crude exports were up 140,000 bpd at 2.15 million.
